jobs.description: 산업입지정보시스템(ILIS) 산업단지 고시와 그 첨부 (root ADR-0484; scripts/ops/industrial-complex-notice-collect.sh): the notice list in one request, then the notices the lakehouse does not record as settled (silver.industrial_complex_notice_detail), newest first, at most notice_detail.per_run_limit and until its run_time_budget_seconds, two seconds between requests. Each attachment still in use is downloaded and stored once, whatever its format (pdf, hwp, hwpx, zip, a picture, else bin), in the shared content-addressed media store; the details land in Bronze, notice_detail.commit_every notices to an object, each attachment annotated with its hash, format, size, source URL and outcome. A settled notice is never asked again (a change is a new notice). Reads nothing inside the files: extraction is the intelligence platform's, on ai-server, later. No Spark.

first_run.estimated_from: computed from its own bounds: the list in one request (13.5 MB, measured 2026-11-09 in a few seconds) and then notices until notice_detail.run_time_budget_seconds (1,800 s) stops the loop, the last notice (one detail and about one attachment, two seconds between requests) finishing after it: about 1,900 s, inside the 2,160 s share of the 40-minute limit. Each 50 notices commit on their own (as_it_goes).

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: The provider publishes notices on no fixed day (endpoint catalog expected_cadence irregular, ilis-industrial_complex_notice_detail); that the job runs and finishes is its done expectation (root ADR-0480 §1).

jobs.description: Silver load of the ILIS notice reads and attachments (root ADR-0484; infra/lakehouse/spark/jobs/industryland_or_kr.py): the notice detail objects no commit of silver.industrial_complex_notice_detail records (plan-silver-load-objects, R2 alone), oldest first, each committed on its own: first its attachments in the store to silver.industrial_complex_notice_attachment (new or changed (notice, hash) only), then one read row per notice to silver.industrial_complex_notice_detail. `unchanged` without Spark when nothing is owed.

first_run.estimated_from: computed from court_auction_silver, the same plan-then-container Spark load (measured 278 s for one run); one collector run leaves at most eight objects (400 notices, 50 to an object), so about twice it, 600 s, inside the 2,160 s share of the 40-minute limit

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its collector wrote a notice object; that it is not behind its inputs is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333).

assets.title: 산업단지 고시 읽은 기록
assets.description: ILIS 고시 상세를 읽을 때마다(실패 포함) 고시 하나에 한 행을 쌓는다: 고시 번호·단지 코드·제목·고시일·종류·첨부 수. 수집기가 다음 실행에 물을 고시를 이 표에서 계산한다(루트 ADR-0484).

assets.title: 산업단지 고시 첨부
assets.description: 고시마다 그 첨부(PDF·HWP·HWPX·ZIP·그림, 그 밖은 bin)를 내용 해시로 한 번씩 쌓는다: 파일 이름·제공자 크기·출처 URL·받은 시각·형식·바이트 수. 바이트는 공용 content-addressed 미디어 저장소에 한 번만 있다(루트 ADR-0298, ADR-0484). 읽기·추출은 이 표로 저장소를 찾아 intelligence platform 이 ai-server 에서 나중에 한다

dependencies.description: 아직 끝나지 않은 고시의 상세를 새 것부터 묻고 읽은 기록을 쌓는다(루트 ADR-0484).
고시의 첨부를 형식에 상관없이 받아 공용 미디어 저장소에 내용 해시로 한 번만 담고, 색인을 쌓는다(루트 ADR-0484).
수집기가 매 실행 이 표의 마지막 읽음으로 물을 고시를 계산한다: 목록의 고시 중 마지막 읽음이 끝나지(read) 않은 것, 새 것부터(루트 ADR-0484 §3).
